summary: GitHub repository observers retain completed reads when a local request budget cuts a poll short, resuming without sending the completed request prefix again. Partial facts remain private until the complete observation is ready.

replay.detail: No claims are replayed or rewritten.

schema.detail: No table or wire schema change. The existing private plugin cursor may contain an unfinished poll journal, limited to 1 MiB and two hours.

rules.detail: Admission limits and scheduling ownership are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No new observer state. Local refusal remains an error, not a successful observation. Other errors discard staged progress and retain the last completed cursor. Oversized journals keep the previous cursor; expired journals restart from the last completed cursor.

recovery.detail: An older build ignores the journal fields and refills from GitHub. Rollback can repeat requests but does not publish staged facts.
